content.hardestProblem: Matching a passenger to a driver whose existing route already passes near them, rather than dispatching a dedicated trip, so a ride costs the driver a detour instead of a journey.
limitations: berearides.com is the product landing page, not the running app. The build is not yet publicly installable, so the system itself cannot be inspected from here.
No public source or case study yet.
Usage during the campus beta was not instrumented, so there are no measured results to report.
The matching algorithm has not been benchmarked against a naive proximity baseline.
content.problem: Students on a residential campus of 1,600+ coordinate rides to town, airports, and home through group chats, where offers and requests are easily missed and there is no record of who committed to what.

evidence.title: Route-overlap matching: approach, alternatives, and tradeoffs

summary: A community rideshare app for a residential campus, pairing passengers with drivers whose existing routes overlap theirs, with authenticated accounts and real-time ride status. Founded, built, and beta-tested on campus.
tagline: Rideshare matching by route overlap rather than dedicated dispatch, beta-tested on a 1,600+ student campus.
title: Berea Rides Campus Mobility Network
